name: @muzi3/hc
description: Pi extensions for herdr-core (hc): /hc-reload reloads skills, extensions and keybindings in every pi window in place, and herdr-agent-state reports working/blocked/idle to the herdr pane so waiting-for-input panes show as blocked.
